impact_scope.description: S1 introduces the anchored public xxHash64 checksum callable; no matching declaration exists in S0.
H0 would need to enable the new xxhash64 module and add a path that reaches hasher.checksum_u64.

evidence: The selected S0 declaration context states that no matching declaration exists.
Because hasher.checksum_u64 is absent in S0, its own exposure gap is false under the identity rule.
S1 declares pub func hasher.checksum_u64() base.u64 in the newly added std/xxhash64 module.
H0 enables only AUX__BASE, AUX__JSON, BASE, and JSON modules; it neither enables xxhash64 nor constructs its hasher or calls checksum_u64.
H0's fuzz paths exclusively exercise JSON decoding and do not provide one-hop reachability to the new checksum callable.

new_harness_obligation.description: To expose the anchored S1 callable, H0 must enable the xxhash64 module and add a fuzz path that initializes/updates an xxhash64 hasher and calls hasher.checksum_u64; these actions were unnecessary while the declaration was absent in S0.
evidence: The xxhash64 production module and hasher.checksum_u64 are newly introduced in S1.
The unchanged JSON harness has no xxhash64 module configuration or checksum call.

reason: For the identical anchored unit, Gap(S0,H0)=false because the public callable did not exist, while Gap(S1,H0)=true because the new callable is unreachable from H0 without new module configuration and a new call path. The fixed truth table therefore yields NEW, which requires harness maintenance.
